name: SAR Filing by MLRO — Journey Event Catalogue
description: All domain events introduced by JRN-003. Six new events: three within the SAR investigation/filing lifecycle (SVC-014 owned), two in the consent regime (SVC-014 owned), and one account action event (SVC-001 owned, triggered by the SARFiled signal). All SAR events are classified as auditor_only and routed to the WORM audit pipeline. The SARFiled event payload is deliberately minimal to enforce the tipping-off prohibition.
tipping_off_design_note: EVT-016 (SARFiled) carries ONLY customer_id and restriction_required. It does not carry the NCA reference, SAR narrative, grounds of suspicion, or any investigation detail. This design ensures that even if a downstream consumer of EVT-016 (e.g. SVC-001) is accessed by an unauthorised party, no SAR-identifying information could be disclosed to a subject.

events.name: SARInvestigationOpened
events.trigger: SVC-014 creates a SARInvestigationRecord when a suspicion trigger is received — either an automated event (SanctionsHitDetected EVT-006, FraudScoreCompleted) or a manual staff disclosure submitted via SVC-015 case management. Published immediately on record creation.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory). SVC-103 and SVC-111 receive it for audit/WORM pipeline purposes — these are shared infrastructure services, not separate capabilities.

consumers.action: Triggers MLRO case management alert. Adds investigation to MLRO dashboard.
Creates immutable audit log entry for investigation opening.
Routes event to 7-year WORM retention store.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-investigations.
events.worm_rationale: SAR investigation records must be retained for 7 years WORM (MLR 2017 Regulation 40). All investigation lifecycle events are included in the WORM pipeline.

events.name: SARDecisionMade
events.trigger: MLRO records their formal decision in SVC-014 case management (via SVC-015 UI). Decision may be file_sar, file_defensive_sar, or dismissed. Event is published immediately on decision record creation. Starts the 5-business-day SLA clock where decision = file or file_defensive.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Decision event consumed only within CAP-005 and shared infrastructure (SVC-103, SVC-111).

payload_schema.sar_id: string (UUID v4) — null if decision = dismissed
payload_schema.sla_deadline: string (ISO 8601 date — 5 business days from decision_date, null if dismissed)

events.payload_note: mlro_decision_rationale is NOT included in the event payload — it stays in the SARInvestigationRecord entity. The rationale may contain detailed SAR grounds that should not be propagated via the event bus.

consumers.action: Updates MLRO case management dashboard with decision status and SLA countdown.
Creates immutable audit log entry for MLRO decision with attribution.
Routes event to 7-year WORM retention store.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-investigations.
events.worm_rationale: MLRO decision is a legally significant act. The decision record and its timestamp are evidence of the bank's discharge (or failure to discharge) of its POCA 2002 obligation.

events.name: SARFiled
events.trigger: SVC-014 receives acknowledgement from the NCA SAR Online system confirming the SAR has been received and assigned an NCA reference number. Published immediately on NCA acknowledgement receipt. This is the primary cross-capability event — consumed by SVC-001 for account restriction coordination.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for account restriction application. Also consumed by SVC-103 and SVC-111. Crosses the CAP-005 → CAP-001 boundary.

payload_schema.sar_id: string (UUID v4) — internal SAR reference only
payload_schema.restriction_required: boolean — true if MLRO has determined account restrictions are needed

events.payload_design_decision: The NCA reference, grounds of suspicion, typology codes, transaction details, and SAR narrative are DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from this payload. The payload contains only the minimum required for SVC-001 to act on the restriction signal. This enforces the POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off prohibition at the architecture level — no SAR detail can propagate to services that could surface it to the customer.

consumers.action: Reads restriction_required flag. If true, applies enhanced_monitoring_flag to all accounts belonging to customer_id. Does NOT receive or store SAR detail. Account restriction notices to customer use generic pre-approved language only.
Creates immutable audit log entry for SAR filing event.
Routes event to 7-year WORM retention store.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-filings.
events.worm_rationale: SAR filing event is the definitive record of the bank's NCA disclosure. Timestamp is evidence of SLA compliance (5-business-day window). Retained 7 years WORM.
explicit_consumer_restrictions: SVC-017 (Digital Channels): MUST NOT consume this event — explicit deny rule at event bus subscription level
SVC-053 (Notification Service): MUST NOT consume this event
Any customer-facing service: MUST NOT consume this event

events.name: SARConsentRequested
events.trigger: Published when a consent SAR is filed — i.e. the MLRO has filed a SAR seeking NCA permission before processing a specific transaction (POCA 2002 s338 authorised disclosure consent regime). Published at the same time as SARFiled (EVT-016) when consent_requested = true.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to place the specific transaction on hold pending NCA consent.

payload_schema.consent_transaction_ref: string — internal transaction ID for which NCA consent is sought
payload_schema.moratorium_expiry_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — filing_date + 7 calendar days (NCA initial moratorium window)

consumers.action: Places the transaction identified by consent_transaction_ref on hold. Fail-closed: transaction remains blocked until SARConsentGranted (EVT-018) is received or MLRO manually resolves. Customer sees generic 'transaction temporarily unavailable' message.
Creates immutable audit log of consent moratorium start.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-filings. Must be consumed by SVC-001 before any transaction processing attempt for consent_transaction_ref.

events.name: SARConsentGranted
events.trigger: Published when NCA grants consent for the transaction identified in the consent SAR, or when the NCA moratorium expires without a refusal (7 days from filing with no NCA response = deemed consent). MLRO records the NCA consent grant via the POST /sars/{id}/consent-response endpoint. NOT published when NCA refuses consent.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to release the transaction hold.

payload_schema.consent_transaction_ref: string — transaction for which consent was granted
payload_schema.nca_response_reference: string — NCA consent reference (null if moratorium_expired with no NCA response)

consumers.action: Releases the transaction hold for consent_transaction_ref. This is the ONLY signal that may release the hold — failure of SVC-014 does not release the hold.
Creates immutable audit log of consent resolution.

events.not_published_when: NCA refuses consent. In that case, no consent-granted event is ever published and the transaction hold remains permanently until MLRO manually resolves.
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-filings. Must be processed by SVC-001 before consent_transaction_ref processing is unblocked.

events.name: AccountRestrictionApplied
events.trigger: SVC-001 applies an enhanced monitoring flag or account restriction to a customer's accounts on receipt of the SARFiled (EVT-016) event with restriction_required = true. Published to confirm the restriction has been applied.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001). Consumed by SVC-103 for audit purposes. No cross-capability consumer.

payload_schema.account_ids: array<string (UUID v4)> — all accounts belonging to customer_id to which restriction was applied
payload_schema.trigger_sar_id: string (UUID v4) — internal reference only, NOT surfaced to customer

events.payload_note: trigger_sar_id is included in this event for audit trail completeness (SVC-103 and SVC-111 logging only). SVC-001 must not surface trigger_sar_id in any customer-facing API response or UI.

consumers.action: Creates immutable audit log entry for account restriction application. Links restriction to SAR via trigger_sar_id.
Routes to WORM retention for annual MLRO report data aggregation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.accounts.
events.worm_rationale: Account restriction applied as a consequence of SAR filing must be retained as part of the SAR audit trail. 7-year WORM co-located with SAR records.
